randomness: None: deterministic upstream circular pupil case
case_text:
# Small-pupil AO regime; identical optical physics to mft_array_scan.
# The fixed focal grid makes this an MFT scan, not an FFT latency claim.
# Tail estimates are empirical; the observed maximum is not a worst-case bound.
id: mft_ao_scan
kind: pupil_to_focus
algorithm_class: matrix_dft
wavelength_m: 632.8e-9
pupil:
  diameter_m: 0.01
  samples_across_diameter: 32
  array_samples: 32
  aperture: circular
output:
  focal_length_m: 1.0
  samples_per_lambda_f_d: 4.0
  extent_lambda_f_d: 32.0
dtype: complex128
basis_caching: precomputed
scan:
  parameter: n_pupil
  values: [32, 64, 96, 128, 192, 256]
execution:
  warmup: 10
  repeats: 1000
  timeout_s: 300.0
accuracy:
  reference: internal_mft
  max_rel_l2: 1.0e-10
notes: >
  Small-pupil scan for AO component latency. Focal grid and accuracy gate match
  mft_array_scan. Timing runs belong on a local machine, never in CI. Inspect
  the full stored distribution and machine fingerprint before interpreting tails.
config_text:
id: dragrace_cpu_all
device: cpu
fft_backend: numpy
blas_backend: accelerate
threads: 8
conda_env: null
notes: >
  Local Apple Silicon run. Affinity cannot be enforced on macOS. All available
  cores; actual CPU/wall ratio remains in raw data. FFT/BLAS nonselectability
  and strict backend verification remain enforced by the upstream adapters.
